description.zh: yysz 维护的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for task completion, failure, blocking, and pending questions. Shows the workspace name, its path, the run time, and what happened; click to open that chat.
description.zh: 任务完成、失败、阻塞或等待你回答时弹出 Windows 系统通知，带工作区名字、路径、本次耗时和具体内容；点击可跳到对应会话。
